Remark
[Einstein metric via a rescaling function]

Source: petersen:page-0173 ↗ prop:pet-ch4-rotsym-ricci-scalar 1. ch4:4.7.11Let $(N^{n-1},g_N)$ have $\mathrm{Ric}=\tfrac {n-2}2\lambda g_N$, $\lambda <0$. Find $\rho :\mathbb {R}\to (0,\infty )$ so that $(M^n,g)=(\mathbb {R}\times N,dr^2+\rho ^2(r)g_N)$ is Einstein with $\mathrm{Ric}=\lambda g$.
